TBC Dungeon Diving quests are now based on LFG completion instead of specific dungeons, this aims to make queue times faster and a QOL improvement over having to find a specific dungeon group.

Vanilla Gathering and Crafting quests are now available in TBC in addition to the dedicated TBC profession quests. This intends to keep the vanilla materials more useful throughout the TBC expansion while addressing a mark deficit between vanilla and TBC.
